name: local-motion
description: Turn a private local coding agent on and off inside VS Code and Cursor.

commands.title: Local Motion: Turn On Local Agent
Local Motion: Repair Local Agent Setup
Local Motion: Connect Cursor to Local Agent

localMotion.llamaServerPath.description: Optional absolute path to llama-server. If empty, Local Motion searches PATH and Homebrew locations.

localMotion.contextTokens.description: Context window to request from llama-server.

localMotion.parallelRequests.description: Number of parallel requests to allow in llama-server.

localMotion.downloadConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent HTTP range requests to use when downloading large GGUF model files.

localMotion.proxyPort.description: Preferred localhost port for the Cursor-facing OpenAI proxy. Local Motion falls back to an ephemeral port if this port is already in use.

localMotion.cursorTunnel.description: Expose the local proxy to Cursor via a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. Experimental: prompts will transit Cursor's servers and the tunnel. Applies on the next model start.

localMotion.cursorTunnelUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS base URL for a user-managed tunnel, such as a Cloudflare Named Tunnel. When set, Local Motion uses this instead of spawning a Quick Tunnel. Applies on the next model start.

localMotion.defaultModelRepo.description: Default Hugging Face GGUF repository shown in Advanced Model Settings and tried first by Local Motion before its built-in, biggest-first fallback repositories. Defaults to a 30B mixture-of-experts coder; smaller Macs automatically fall through to the largest model that fits.

localMotion.openSetupOnStartup.description: Open Local Motion setup automatically once on first startup when no model has been installed.

localMotion.runAutomagicalSetupOnFirstSt.description: Run setup automatically once on first startup when no model has been installed. Off by default so Local Motion shows the local-agent switch before installing llama.cpp or downloading the first compatible GGUF model from the default or fallback repositories.

localMotion.resumeAutomagicalSetupOnStar.description: After the local agent is connected once, restart the installed local model automatically on future startups without downloading a new model, opening setup, opening Cursor settings, or replacing the clipboard.
